reviews.text: Cool app BUT…. I’ve been using this app for almost a year and I love it. However I’ve got disappointed. I’ve never used the feature to upload a photo, until now that I started to wanting to track my progress at least visually. The problem is that if you upload it directly from the camera, once you upload it you don’t have a way to download it. It should either leave a copy of that photo in your photos app or at least allow you to download it. Yes I know it allows you to share it as a story or download it but if you share it as a story it adds some stats which can’t be removed, and if you save it, it will only save the stats with a grey background instead the picture. It doesn’t say anywhere that that is a premium feature and why would keeping your own picture be a premium feature anyways. If you tell me that the photo is included in the workout analysis screen ok I’m willing to upgrade but then make sure to specify that in the upgrade to premium screen which now it doesn’t say anything just the price. Also there should be a way to change the units for exercises time based so that at least we log the time we start performing an exercise and the progress overtime. I hope you guys read this and can improve that. Thank you!

Amazing app but one thing I would change to make it even better. I keep using this app as it helps track my progress rather easily and effectively which is great but often I will be working out and I press a button on accident as you do when hyped up and sweating and the whole workout gets deleted. Today I accidentally pressed the top left button (down arrow) and my workout completely resets (3 hours in😭😭😭) you can imagine how frustrated I was.

Edit: I’ve yet to find this problem again so I added one star, but if it were perfect I’d like to have a little more knowledge on the muscles I’m actually working on, and potentially other lifter’s personally workout routines/ things that would help me improve,I assume Ai could be beneficial in that regard instead of making a workout that doesn’t always feel right. I would love to see new features that make the main app much more well-rounded. Obviously I think it’s great now!

Edit: the reset bugs are happening more often and it’s becoming unusable, I’m going back to pen and paper
